data.rationale: This commit changes foreign key (RI) checking logic in ri_triggers.c to direct FK checks that require an implicit cast function through SPI rather than the RI fast path. The fast path continues to handle binary-compatible types, cross-type operators, and domains, while ri_check_fastpath_index checks pg_cast eligibility and caches the decision. Reaching these changed code paths requires creating foreign key constraints between columns of coercible types (e.g. int referencing bigint, or custom implicit casts) and performing INSERT or UPDATE operations that trigger foreign key validation.

alter_table @scope
  : <1> ALTER TABLE @target(plain) ADD FOREIGN KEY "(" @target_col(int) ")" REFERENCES "t1" "(" "c0" ")"
  | <1> ALTER TABLE @target(plain) ADD FOREIGN KEY "(" @target_col(bigint) ")" REFERENCES "t1" "(" "c0" ")"
  | <0.5> ALTER TABLE @target(plain) ADD FOREIGN KEY "(" @target_col(numeric) ")" REFERENCES "t2" "(" "c0" ")"
  ;
